subject.title: Discord account-to-agent routing falls back to default agent instead of matching by account name

question: Should Discord multi-account routing add a guarded same-name accountId-to-agent fallback when no explicit binding matches, or should explicit bindings remain the only supported contract?
rationale: The source-level behavior is clear, but either direction changes permission-sensitive fallback semantics across session state, model/provider choice, and Discord delivery behavior.

options.title: Approve Guarded Fallback
options.body: Route non-default Discord account IDs to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with distinct diagnostics, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Keep Explicit Bindings Only
options.body: Leave runtime routing unchanged and add doctor/status/docs warnings for Discord accounts that appear intended to bind to same-named agents.

options.title: Repair Or Replace Linked PR
options.body: Use the linked fork PR as source material only after resolving conflicts, adding a configured-agent guard, and supplying real Discord proof.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Fallback
recommendation.body: Route non-default Discord account IDs to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with distinct diagnostics, docs, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on multi-agent routing and the fallback compatibility policy is a maintainer routing-contract decision.
